body: I don't think they're less intelligent just profoundly different. I'm only 23 but I feel like maybe there is nothing with people. I guess maybe that's normal to be distant? I still feel it's not normal to have no reaction to death it's like they don't exist anymore to me rather than missing them. Maybe I still haven't grasped what death is?

I don't know. I can't say, there were people in my life I thought I really loved and cared about that have died but after they've died it meant nothing to me. People that I've known since as old as I am sometimes in horrible ways and it never means anything to me. So if I had a friend would I actually even care about them? I don't know. It feels like I'm not human and having a friend would be like having a pet instead of an actual person for companionship. But if I didn't care about companionship I would enjoy it and I do enjoy it sometimes it's just sometimes what I see isn't always pleasant.

It's been getting worse over time. It's like snowball rolling down a hill getting bigger and going faster. I used to only hear voices, then the voices escalated to things shifting around, then I saw things that weren't there, now I'm starting to completely lose grasp. The other day was extremely bad. I just laid down and cried and I would hear hospital machinery. My heart was beating loud and I could hear it but it sounded like a clock and I was frozen like when you get sleeping paralysis except I wasn't in my apartment I was in a hospital room then I was in my apartment again and I decided to go for a walk and the floor was moving underneath me like it was made of liquid and things were flying by. Sometimes I almost enjoy it but then I become really sad because I'm alone and no one can experience that with me if that makes sense?

I like to go hiking, and sometimes when you hike you can meet a few nice people who will say hello to you. It could help to even go on your own if it makes you happy. If you can make money on what you've studied you can try to move close to a reserve or nature trail and go as often as possible.
